{{Quote|Have you seen the latest on Senator Herbin? It's all over HNE. Dating that awful holovid actress from ''Republic Medcenter''. The one who protests about the war.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
'''''Republic Medcenter''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] that had begun circulating<ref name="No Prisoners" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were both critical of the production, the latter condemning the performance of a [[Unidentified actress|starring actress]] as "awful."<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Republic Medcenter'' was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' , which was released in [[2009]] and written by [[Karen Traviss]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' multimedia project.<ref name="No Prisoners" />
